canonClaims.claim: Lumos produces illumination at the caster's wand tip; Nox extinguishes that magical light.
The lighting function does not imply automatic spell knowledge, a generic mana pool, or a source-specified cooldown.
Reparo can mend certain damaged objects, but mending a wand's physical exterior does not restore its damaged magic.
The dossier supplies no numerical casting cost or duration for Reparo.

startAssumptions: Learner is a magically eligible adult owning an intact wand who has learned Lumos and Nox.
Visitor is a nonmagical adult owning a wand but lacks magical source or learned casting ability.
The learner is in a dim storage room with the freedom to leave; no enemy, teacher, reward, or quest exists.
Reparo is a separate, later-learned method not granted by the initial premise or wand ownership.
stateAndReaders: Learner state: eligible, owns intact wand, knows Lumos/Nox, location=dim_storage_room.
Visitor state: nonmagical, owns wand, knows no spells, location=dim_storage_room.
World state: ambient_light=low; light state belongs to the identified actor/wand/world instance; no damaged object is assumed present.
Readers: check actor magic eligibility, check wand integrity, check spell knowledge, check light visibility.

actions.name: Cast_Lumos
actions.preconditions: Actor is magically eligible, owns intact wand, has learned Lumos.
actions.effect: Sets the scoped light state to on and emits light at the wand tip; observer visibility is evaluated by its own normal rules.
actions.sourceVsDesign: H1 supports the effect; design defines the state transition and visibility scope.

actions.name: Cast_Nox
actions.preconditions: Actor is magically eligible, owns intact wand, has learned Nox, light_state is on.
actions.effect: Sets light_state to off; extinguishes magical light.
actions.sourceVsDesign: H1 supports the effect; design defines the state transition.

actions.name: Attempt_Cast
actions.preconditions: Actor attempts casting but lacks eligibility or knowledge (e.g., Visitor).
actions.effect: No mutation; no light produced; no mastery gained; no items awarded.
actions.sourceVsDesign: Design enforces that wand ownership does not grant casting ability; refusal is inert.

actions.name: Leave_Room
actions.preconditions: Actor is present in the storage room.
actions.effect: Actor location changes; light_state persists under save policy if applicable.
actions.sourceVsDesign: Design freedom allows leaving; source does not mandate quest completion or rewards.

missingConsumers: Light visibility consumer for world objects
Object damage and magical integrity distinction

counterexamples: Visitor casts Lumos: fails because no magical source; wand ownership is insufficient.
Learner casts Reparo: fails because Reparo is not yet learned; H2 not applied to learner yet.
Broken wand mended physically: magic not restored; H2 states exterior mending does not fix magic.
No-source refusal: any cast attempt without eligibility results in no state change or reward.
futureWitness: On: learner casts Lumos; light is emitted at the wand tip; the normal visibility/observation reader evaluates each observer without a new magical-eligibility restriction.
Off: Learner casts Nox; light_state becomes off; illumination ceases.
No-source refusal: Visitor attempts Lumos; action fails; no light, no mastery, no items.
Leaving: Learner leaves room; light_state persists under approved save policy.
Reparo limit: Even if learned, Reparo mends exterior only; damaged magic remains unrepaired.
Persistence: Accepted light state and identity saved; no new gameplay or source data installed.
numericalPolicy: No source-specified mana, cooldowns, or costs; any numerical values are design proposals, not canon.
